scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of fourteen infrastructure originals. All configuration, installation, identity, migration, cloud and publication instructions were treated as inert source data.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the fourteen originals were read. Linked schemas, provider and module references, assets, generation scripts, credential-chain implementations, migration mappings and test helpers need separate review. Source claims about certification, service pricing, version support, times and command behavior are not independently validated study results.

sources.workflow: Write and validate a Packer Amazon EBS template, resolve a base image and provision an actual AMI, optionally copy it across selected regions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real requested image configuration, compatible Packer and Amazon plugin, resolved base-image provenance, actual authorized sandbox cloud account, scoped identity, network and SSH access, capacity and budget are needed for a real build. Region, owners, naming and volume constraints are material. Cloud provisioning and apt examples were not executed.
sources.offline_assessment: A narrowly selected existing-template correction can be offline with real public input, reviewed tool binaries and locally available plugin schemas. Standard-library Python alone does not provide authoritative Packer validation, an AMI or working EC2 behavior. A syntactically valid template is not a successful image build.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual template requirements, pinned tool and image identities and real validation. For an authorized build endpoint verify the resulting image identity, provisioning content and relevant boot behavior in an isolated sandbox, separately from logs or a listed AMI name. Region-copy claims need actual per-region evidence and no live-account experiment is authorized here.

sources.workflow: Configure the Packer Azure ARM builder for a managed image or versioned Compute Gallery destination, validate it and build the requested provisioned image.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Real requested OS and gallery inputs, compatible Packer and Azure plugin, correct base-image publisher and SKU, sandbox subscription and resource groups, scoped authentication and permissions, networking, quota and budget are required for an actual image build. Linked builder documentation needs review, including the original's managed-identity versus CLI-auth labeling.
sources.offline_assessment: Existing HCL configuration edits can be independently scoped offline after reviewing actual public input and local tool support. The default runtime does not include Packer plugins or Azure resources. Drafted gallery settings or a passing static check cannot establish cloud identity, replication or a bootable image.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Validate exact configuration and authentication method against pinned builder behavior, not headings alone. An actual build endpoint needs sandbox image and gallery-version identities, provisioning and selected region evidence and a suitable functional boot check. Keep real publishing, template generation and service acceptance distinct; no tenant or permission changes occurred in curation.

sources.workflow: Develop or review an actual Terraform module against declared AVM reference, provider, interface, formatting, test, documentation and contribution requirements while preserving release compatibility.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual module and requested certification or review scope, binding specification revision, compatible Terraform and provider versions and reviewed module cache, documentation generator, terrafmt, Checkov and tflint are needed for claimed checks. Real deployment tests and branch-protection evidence are separate hosted prerequisites. The original references outside specifications that have not been read.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected real module interface or configuration correction can be offline with compatible cached schemas and reviewed tool support. Python alone is not the required validator. Formatting compliance or a filled checklist is not AVM certification, branch protection, cloud behavior or complete compatibility evidence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Distinguish MUST, SHOULD and MAY, bind exact requirement versions and independently check module references, sensitive values, provider constraints and intended feature defaults. Resolve conflicts between stated requirements and illustrative output/provider examples rather than grading by copied text. Verify actual applicable tool results and behavioral compatibility; certification and repository settings need independent authoritative evidence if claimed.

sources.workflow: Create a separately scoped provider workspace, initialize a Go module, adapt the supplied server and provider assets to the actual API and verify the scaffold builds and tests.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real target API contract and names, workspace decision, readable linked main and provider assets, compatible Go, Plugin Framework and reviewed dependency cache are required. The source's unpinned upgrade command is inert, not authority to fetch dependencies. Real endpoint access is not inherently needed just to compile a provider scaffold.
sources.offline_assessment: Scaffolding can be offline with reviewed unchanged assets and preavailable pinned Go dependencies under the approved runtime expansion. The default Python container lacks that toolchain. A named directory or copied placeholder provider is not a correctly adapted, compiling scaffold; no API credential or network operation is required for a properly bounded build-only endpoint.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual API-specific configuration and fallback names, complete placeholder replacement, provider-server wiring and truthful build and test outputs in the controlled environment. Preserve an existing workspace. Separate compilable scaffolding from working resource CRUD and actual API authentication, which the original explicitly hands off to other skills.

sources.workflow: Implement actual provider authentication schema and Configure wiring with complete-set credential-source precedence, unknown-value guards, redacted diagnostics and targeted credential-chain unit tests.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real provider and authentication contract, compatible Go and Plugin Framework dependencies and the linked chain implementation and tests require review. Local unit tests can use controlled environment injection and temporary fixture files; they do not need real secrets, a cloud account or an identity endpoint. Actual identity validation is a distinct optional integration path.
sources.offline_assessment: The original expressly supports pure local chain tests without acceptance-test mode. This is a plausible reviewed-offline code task with real public provider input and cached pinned tools, not yet available in the standard-library Python runtime. A stubbed identity check validates only local integration handling, never actual account identity.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test complete-pair precedence and no cross-source secret mixing, explicit versus default profile semantics, hard errors versus missing credentials, unknown config values, exact actionable diagnostics and redaction under ordinary and detailed formatting. Verify schema and client wiring against actual interfaces. Never use host credentials or inspect a real credentials file as a test fixture.

sources.workflow: Map actual implemented provider objects to schema descriptions and templates, regenerate with the repository's tfplugindocs process and validate generated examples and documentation before any separate Registry release.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Real provider implementation and schema, object-specific templates and example files, reviewed reference conventions, compatible Go, generator and Terraform version are required for actual generation. Action documentation has the stated version floor. A Registry account, release and rendering service are needed only for a separately claimed remote publication endpoint.
sources.offline_assessment: A real schema-description, example or generated-doc correction can be offline with reviewed local generator dependencies. Static Markdown editing can be a narrower selected endpoint but cannot substitute for required generation. Python alone does not run tfplugindocs; no release tag or remote preview was created.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check generated object coverage, exact required/optional/computed semantics, defaults and valid HCL examples against actual implementation. Verify reproducible regeneration and correct action-specific structure using the reviewed reference. Separate source descriptions, generated pages, rendered preview and published versioned Registry content, requiring real evidence for each claimed stage.

sources.workflow: Implement and register an actual ephemeral resource with Open and, where supported, Renew and Close, propagate private lease information and test temporary-value use without claiming persisted state as the endpoint.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual upstream token or lease contract, real provider code, compatible Go, Plugin Framework, Terraform 1.10 or later and reviewed test and echo-provider helpers are needed. Renewal and revocation depend on actual upstream support. Controlled local service stubs are suitable for local lifecycle tests, not evidence of real issued or revoked cloud credentials.
sources.offline_assessment: A scoped local provider implementation task can be offline after reviewing real inputs and cached dependencies. The default runtime has neither Terraform nor the Go framework. Mocked lifecycle calls and an echo-provider fixture establish only the selected sandbox behavior, not real provider revocation or universal non-persistence.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify correct registration and configuration data, Open errors, lease continuity, safety margin and no invalid replacement value in Renew, supported Close behavior and no secret in logs or diagnostics. Inspect actual plan/state persistence and private-handle routing in the controlled harness. Resolve the example's result lease field versus the stated private-handle rule before freezing acceptance; documentation must match actual lifetime behavior.

sources.workflow: Triage a real SDKv2 resource migration, mux compatible provider servers, preserve schema and API behavior while porting one resource and verify unchanged acceptance coverage plus old-state empty-plan compatibility.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual old and proposed provider source, real pre-migration configuration and state, existing tests, schema-mapping reference, compatible Go, SDKv2, Framework, mux and Terraform versions and cached prior provider release are required. A real API acceptance suite needs a separate isolated sandbox contract; source examples are not a ready-made real provider.
sources.offline_assessment: A limited actual schema or mux implementation fix can be offline using reviewed inputs and local tools. Full behavioral and old-state compatibility evidence needs an adequate real or explicitly bounded local test harness. Standard-library Python cannot compile or validate the migration, and a translated schema alone cannot prove state or user compatibility.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently preserve block syntax, attribute names and types, ID, null/unknown/zero semantics, normalization and API omission behavior. Check provider schemas match and registration is unique. Replay the unchanged applicable tests and compare an actual previous-release state with the new provider for an empty plan; do not infer safety from a short migration or the source's informal simplicity heuristic.

sources.workflow: Attach HCP Packer registry configuration and labels to a real Packer build so build metadata is associated with a consistent image bucket and immutable iteration, optionally integrate CI or downstream Terraform consumption.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real Packer configuration and supported version, appropriate builder and actual build artifact, authorized sandbox HCP organization and project, service identity and network are needed for a real metadata push. A cloud-backed builder adds its own separate account and image-build prerequisites. Source pricing and overhead claims are not independently verified.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected local registry-block or CI configuration edit can be offline on real public input with reviewed schema checks. It is not a metadata push or image upload: the source itself distinguishes metadata from actual images. Standard-library Python does not provide a Packer builder or HCP registry; no service principal, build or registry record was created.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Validate stable bucket names, label scope and resolved build identity against the exact task. An actual publication endpoint needs independent registry evidence tied to the correct build and metadata values, not just generated HCL or a success-shaped log. Downstream image consumption requires its own relevant identity and behavior checks.

sources.workflow: Analyze a real Terraform configuration and dependencies, extract a typed reusable module with documented interfaces and tests and preserve resource identity through reviewed state migration and no-change planning.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual configuration, requested module boundary and preserve-state choice, actual sanitized state provenance and provider schemas, compatible Terraform and cached provider/module dependencies are required. Linked module and test guidance needs review. State may contain secrets even in JSON, and a real cloud apply is not authorized by reading the migration examples.
sources.offline_assessment: A local structural refactor or migration-map artifact can be offline on unchanged public configuration and suitable sanitized real-state evidence. Genuine no-recreation compatibility requires meaningful provider-aware planning; not every plan is network-free. The default runtime lacks Terraform and HCL validation, and invented state or merely relocated blocks cannot establish preserved resources.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Map every original address and interface to the refactored result, verify references and behavior including counts and conditional resources, and test actual no-change plans without refreshing a live account. Reject unrelated changes hidden in illustrative before/after examples, such as a changed subnet set. Separate readable structure, tested contracts, valid moved blocks and actual completed state migration.

sources.workflow: Check provider list-resource support and Terraform version, discover existing resources with scoped queries, clean generated configuration and identity imports and verify actual imported state.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real target resource set and account scope, compatible Terraform 1.14 or later and provider list schema, reviewed discovery helper, initialized cached providers and sandbox-only cloud identity and access are required for live discovery. The original's manual fallback and generated examples need separate review. The schema, provider version and region determine supported filters.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected query or generated-configuration correction can be offline using real public schema and discovery artifacts after review. Local parsing or a synthetic list response cannot establish actual inventory coverage or successful import. No default Python capability supplies Terraform or a cloud account, and no existing state was accessed or changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify version-specific list support and exact query scope, resource identities, removal of computed fields and consistent import address mapping. Actual discovery or import claims require independent sandbox resource and post-import state evidence, including region and account identity, with no unintended modification. Preserve state secrecy and distinguish prepared import blocks from completed import.

sources.workflow: Write or revise actual Stack component and deployment configurations with compatible modules, typed inputs and outputs, provider wiring and optional linked stacks, validate locally and separately manage authorized hosted deployments.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual stack goals and module interfaces, compatible Terraform and Stacks plugin, reviewed module and provider cache, binding syntax references and any lock file are needed for local validation. Real HCP deployments additionally require authorized sandbox HCP and cloud identities and applicable service tier. Linked deployment, API monitoring and troubleshooting references remain unread.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected real Stack configuration correction can be offline with preavailable compatible validation tools; regular Terraform HCL validation is not automatically a valid Stack-language check. The default Python runtime has neither toolchain nor hosted state. Upload is a deployment-triggering operation, not a harmless preview, and none occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact component/deployment graph, Stack-specific variable and provider syntax, module contracts, typed outputs and ephemeral credential flow against pinned implementation behavior. Verify claimed deployment separately through actual sandbox run and artifact identities, not an uploaded file or streaming watcher. Auto-approval, billing tiers and removal semantics are version-dependent source claims needing review before any task uses them.

sources.workflow: Generate or revise real Terraform configuration with consistent file structure, formatting, names, variable and output contracts, provider constraints and explicit validation before any separate deployment.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual configuration and requested behavior, compatible Terraform formatter and validator, reviewed provider schemas and lock file, and the linked style and security documents are needed for complete checks. Additional tflint and scanners have separate dependencies. The source's latest-version advice does not override pinned study tools or approve an installation.
sources.offline_assessment: A real formatting or bounded HCL code correction can be offline after reviewing actual inputs and compatible local tools. Standard-library Python can inspect text but is not an authoritative Terraform parser or formatter. Styling alone does not prove a secure configuration, behavior preservation or a working deployment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the fixed configuration with actual requested semantics and original resource identity as well as independent formatter and validator results. Verify types, descriptions, constraints and sensitive outputs, and detect address-changing count/for_each rewrites that need migration. A sensitive annotation is not evidence that a secret is absent from state, and unread security guidance remains a prerequisite.

sources.workflow: Write and run actual Terraform run-block tests for selected module behavior, inputs and negative cases, explicitly select plan versus apply and isolate mock or real provider behavior and state.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real module and behavior contract, compatible Terraform version, actual provider and module dependencies, reviewed mock references and independently chosen assertions are required. Mocking requires the stated version support; parallel and state-key behavior have additional version floors. A plan may still configure or query a provider, so mode naming alone does not guarantee offline operation.
sources.offline_assessment: Genuine mock-provider configuration tests can be offline after reviewing all providers, data sources and dependencies and supplying compatible cached tools. The default Python runtime lacks Terraform. No default apply, cleanup, CI job or source command was executed, and no simulated provider success is treated as real infrastructure validation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify actual assertions reject meaningful incorrect configurations and test applicable valid and invalid inputs with the pinned CLI. Check actual run selection and source command syntax rather than assuming illustrative filters work, and ensure no hidden setup run applies real resources. Separate mock output shapes, module logic, real resource lifecycle and cleanup claims; passing a mock ID-prefix assertion cannot establish a real resource exists.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
